profile.headline: JD Candidate, Pepperdine Law ‘29
profile.summary:
With 4 years of experience in fast-paced, early-stage start-ups, I’ve developed a strong foundation in building scalable web applications. My passion for problem-solving and collaboration allows me to thrive in high-pressure environments while delivering high-quality, user-centric solutions. While I have developed furthest using JavaScript language, I’m always eager to learn new technologies and adapt to the evolving landscape of software development. 

I’m excited to continue growing my skills and contributing to innovative projects that push boundaries and drive success.
